## Classroom app resources (42)
The app files themselves, served verbatim as MCP resources (resources/list + resources/read) and over plain HTTP at GET /api/apps?id=<id>. Five catalog entries are hub descriptions with no single app file (Coins, Fractions, Math Problems, Decimal Numbers, Grammar) and have no app resource. Each file is the complete interactive app as published on Birkan Yavuz's STEP Academy portal; the SHA-256 below is of the exact file bytes (UTF-8).
